title: What to watch at the open
text: Today is all about NVIDIA. Last night it reported sales of about $115.8 billion for the quarter, more than experts expected, and its forecast for next quarter was also higher than expected. The stock rose in after-hours trading, after closing at $155.46. Watch whether that gain holds when regular trading starts at 9:30 am New York time, and whether chip makers on our list move with it. Nothing on this page is advice; it is here to help us learn.

title: NVIDIA beat expectations, but some analysts cut targets
text: NVIDIA's sales more than doubled compared with a year ago, and it expects about $130 billion next quarter. Even so, the average analyst price target in our data slipped from about $304 to about $287. Some experts worry about the change in leadership after the CEO stepped down. The stock still sits only 7% above its lowest price of the past year.

title: Anthropic may set its stock price tonight
text: Anthropic, a big AI company, is expected to set the price of its new shares this evening and start trading on Nasdaq tomorrow under the ticker ANT. Several companies on our list, like Alphabet, Microsoft, NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom and TSMC, agreed to buy shares too. How this goes could change how investors feel about AI stocks in general.

title: Rocket Lab and Vertiv are the riskiest on our list
text: Rocket Lab has the highest risk score on our list (10 out of 10) and is 64% below its high of the past year. Vertiv scores 8.1 and is about 50% below its high. Big drops like these show how much these stocks can swing, in both directions.

title: Lesson 56: What does "beat estimates" mean?
text: Before a company reports, experts called analysts guess how much it will sell and earn. The average of those guesses is the "estimate." If the real number is higher, the company "beat estimates." If it is lower, it "missed." NVIDIA beat this time: experts expected about $109 billion in sales and it reported about $115.8 billion. But a beat does not always make a stock go up. If investors hoped for an even bigger number, the price can still fall. The stock price reacts to the surprise, not just to the result.

title: What this update covers
text: Prices are from Tuesday's close (November 17). Price targets and money numbers come from FMP for NVIDIA, TSMC, AMD, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Lockheed Martin and GE; the other stocks show price, beta and 52 week range only. The 10 year Treasury rate is a monthly average from Alpha Vantage. News was checked in several reports. Risk scores and scenarios are simple math, not predictions.
